name: IMU demo
robot_urdf:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="sample_bot">
  <link name="base_link">
    <inertial><mass value="5.0"/></inertial>
    <visual><geometry><mesh filename="package://sample_bot/meshes/base.stl"/></geometry></visual>
  </link>

  <link name="lidar_link">
    <inertial><mass value="0.3"/></inertial>
    <visual><geometry><mesh filename="package://sample_bot/meshes/lidar.stl"/></geometry></visual>
  </link>

  <link name="wheel_left_link">
    <inertial><mass value="0.5"/></inertial>
  </link>

  <joint name="base_to_lidar" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="lidar_link"/>
    <origin xyz="0.1 0 0.25" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="base_to_wheel_left" type="continuous">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="wheel_left_link"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0.2 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0" upper="0" effort="10" velocity="5"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
